name: Toast
summary: A short message that appears briefly to confirm something happened, without blocking the page.

anatomy.purpose: Small surface at the bottom (mobile) or a corner (desktop). Has role=status.
One optional action such as Undo.
Required if the toast does not auto-dismiss.

variants.name: Error
variants.use: Report a failed action that is not tied to a field.

contentLimits.message: max 100 characters, say how to fix

whenToUse: Confirm a quick action such as saved, copied, sent.
Offer Undo right after an action.
whenNotToUse: The message is critical or needs a decision: use a modal dialog.
The error belongs to a form field: use inline error text.
Content people must read in full: toasts disappear.

keyboard: If it has an action, the action must be reachable by Tab before it disappears.
accessibility.focus: Do not steal focus. Announce it through a live region instead.
notes: Keep it on screen at least 5 seconds, and longer for more text (WCAG 2.2.1 timing).
Pause the timer on hover and focus.
Do not use a toast as the only place an error appears.
